sentences.text: I have perused the scanned copies of the LCR.
5. The learned Additional Public Prosecutor has raised objection stating that the statement of the victim is yet to be recorded.
6. I have also perused the statement of the victim under Section 164 CrPC.
7. I have considered the submission that the petitioner will not exercise threats to the witnesses.
The petitioner is a local resident and he will cooperate with the trial.
The petitioner will not go near the vicinity of the victim or the informant.
8. After considering the submissions at the Bar with circumspection, petition is allowed.
In the event of violation of any of the conditions mentioned above, bail order shall stand cancelled.

8. After considering the submissions at the Bar with circumspection, petition is allowed.
The petitioner is enlarged on bail of Rs. 50,000/-, with a suitable surety of the like amount, to the satisfaction of the learned trial Court, under the conditions that:-
i) the petitioner will not go near the vicinity of the victim or her parents;
ii) the petitioner will not exercise threats to the witnesses; and iii) the petitioner shall not tamper with the evidence.
In the event of violation of any of the conditions mentioned above, bail order shall stand cancelled.
9. Bail Application stands disposed of.
